svg.aria-label: Software and utilities carry about 42% of the upside
svg.desc: Table of 8 rows with the columns # of companies and 2 stacked-bar panels, EBITDA impact, $bn; Share of 2030 EBITDA, %, each on its own scale. Segments: Run, Grow. The label at the end of each bar is the row total or its range. A bar with a range fills its segments to the low end and runs a light outlined extension to the high end. A Total row closes the table.

text.tspan: Software and utilities carry about 42% of the upside
